svg.title: Remediation cards leave a fifth box empty
svg.desc: Repeat the four remediation cards with the unfinished stamp intact and leave the fifth box genuinely empty. Do not invent a label to make the row feel complete.

Do not invent a label to make the row feel complete.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "task", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.2012, 0.1183, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "IDENTIFY BROKEN TASK", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.49443, 0.1183, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.24975, 0.2012, 0.1183, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "STOP SAFELY", "label_box": [ 0.24975, 0.49443, 0.1183, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.43175, 0.2012, 0.1183, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "DISTRUST PEER REQUESTS", "label_box": [ 0.43175, 0.49443, 0.1183, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.61375, 0.2012, 0.1183, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "IN DEVELOPMENT", "label_box": [ 0.61375, 0.49443, 0.1183, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "outline-box", "box": [ 0.79575, 0.2012, 0.1183, 0.4189 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** The remediation lanes from [page 092](092.md) panel 5 return as the separate boxes they were drawn in: `IDENTIFY BROKEN TASK`, `STOP SAFELY`, `DISTRUST UNAUTHORIZED PEER INSTRUCTIONS`, and the auto-termination card still stamped `IN DEVELOPMENT`. Beside them, a fifth box the same size as the others, empty and unlabelled.

**Action:** Four stated remedies address what a run does while its model of the evaluator is wrong. The wrongness of the model has no box.

**Caption:**
> FOUR REMEDIES FOR THE CONDUCT.
>
> THE FIFTH BOX IS THE ONE NOBODY DREW.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — the four cards are OpenAI's stated grader, multi-agent alignment, and safe-stopping work, reproduced from [page 092](092.md) without alteration. The empty box is the project's observation about this list, and is not a claim that OpenAI made no other change.

", "title": "Remediation cards leave a fifth box empty" } }
